methodology.timing: Synchronous JS+DOM mount, transaction/flush update, reorder and disposal; not paint latency. Warmup excluded.
methodology.ordering: Modes rotated by round, one isolated headless browser/profile. Reference engine for all timed modes.
methodology.cache: 100-operation batches; separate cold compiler/parse, same native site cache lookup, and clone+slot-path resolution.
methodology.memory: Owned live resource counters and disposal checks, not exact heap allocation or GC measurements.
methodology.scope: Syntax prototypes only; no production API or transaction engine selection.
